hero.title: StillGood.
hero.line: Snap your groceries, get reminded before they go off, and find recipes to use them up.

features.title: Scan it. Track it. Cook it.

items.title: Snap to add
items.text: Take a photo of your groceries and the app lists them for you.

items.title: Know what's expiring
items.text: Everything sorted by date, with a reminder before it goes off.

items.title: Cook what you have
items.text: Recipe ideas for the food that needs using first.

items.title: Frésko
items.text: At a student competition, my team designed the idea and reached the grand finals.

items.title: StillGood begins
items.text: I turned the idea into a real app, working on my own.

items.title: Live on Google Play
items.text: Anyone with an Android phone can now download it.

builtWith.title: Built by me, with an AI helper.
builtWith.text: I designed and built the app, the system behind it and the website myself. I used Claude Code, an AI coding assistant, to work faster: I decided how everything should work, and checked every piece of code it wrote before using it.
